About this grimoire

90 cards across five tiers: 24 Major, 46 Modest, 14 Mystery, 4 Master, and 2 Mythic. Card meanings are prompts for reflection. Profile information, event dates and saved readings stay in your browser. This site has no account or reading service.

Sun signs use the tropical zodiac. Sun position, Moon phase, illumination and cycle-return dates are calculated locally with Astronomy Engine. Date-only estimates use noon UTC; time and timezone can change boundary results. Sky cycles offer a reflection lens, not a prediction of life events.
